concepts.definition: Average (mean) gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, expressed as a decimal fraction of men's average base salary (0.16 = 16% in favour of men; negative = in favour of women). Prior-year (2023-24) comparison value; blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers gender pay gap measures; existing financial concepts are income/revenue for the business owner, not pay-gap statistics for an employer reporting unit.

concepts.definition: Average (mean) gender pay gap in total remuneration (base salary plus additional payments such as superannuation, bonuses and overtime) for the employer reporting unit, as a decimal fraction of men's average total remuneration. Prior-year (2023-24) comparison value; blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents remuneration pay gaps; ext.financial.total_income is business income for a period, a different owner, meaning and unit.

concepts.definition: Median gender pay gap in base salary for the employer reporting unit, as a decimal fraction of men's median base salary (negative values indicate a gap in favour of women). Prior-year (2023-24) comparison value; blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers median pay-gap statistics; the shortlist holds no employer-reporting-unit remuneration measures at all.

concepts.definition: Median gender pay gap in total remuneration (base salary plus additional payments) for the employer reporting unit, as a decimal fraction of men's median total remuneration. Prior-year (2023-24) comparison value; blank means no prior-year comparison, not a zero gap.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept represents median total-remuneration pay gaps for an employer reporting unit; existing financial concepts are business income measures with different owner and meaning.
